facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mary came to live in a big house. She was lonely and bored. She found a hidden door. Mary found a garden.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mary Lennox came from India to live in her uncle's big house. The house was dark and cold, and she felt very lonely. One day she wandered around the grounds and found a hidden wall. Mary found a garden behind a locked door in the old wall. She turned the rusty key and pushed the door open slowly. Inside was the most beautiful garden she had ever seen.
